rows.speaker: Torres
rows.en: Enemy mobile suit squadron confirmed! Count... sixty!
rows.display_text:
「Enemy mobile suit squadron confirmed!
Count... sixty!」

rows.speaker: Katz
rows.en: I-I knew this was coming, but seeing it with my own eyes is...
rows.display_text:
「I-I knew this was coming, but seeing it
with my own eyes is...」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Focus, Katz. If we lose even one of our own, the operation's success becomes that much harder.
rows.display_text:
「Focus, Katz. If we lose even one of
our own, the operation's success becomes
that much harder.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: To all units. Operation time is four minutes. In that span, cut down as much of the enemy's strength as you can.
rows.display_text:
「To all units. Operation time is four
minutes. In that span, cut down as much
of the enemy's strength as you can.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: If we shoot down 100 enemy units within four minutes, the operation succeeds.
rows.display_text:
「If we shoot down 100 enemy units
within four minutes, the operation
succeeds.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: The enemy's numbers are endless. Shoot down as many as you can within those four minutes.
rows.display_text:
「The enemy's numbers are endless. Shoot
down as many as you can within those
four minutes.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Understood!
rows.display_text: 「Understood!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Operation Maelstrom, commence! Good luck to every one of you!
rows.display_text:
「Operation Maelstrom, commence! Good
luck to every one of you!」

rows.speaker: Saegusa
rows.en: Four minutes of operation time have elapsed!
rows.display_text:
「Four minutes of operation time have
elapsed!」

rows.speaker: Torres
rows.en: Enemy kill count: {tm}! The Radish and the other ships will begin their charge shortly!
rows.display_text:
「Enemy kill count: {tm}! The Radish
and the other ships will begin their
charge shortly!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: All right... the operation's a success! Well done, everyone!
rows.display_text:
「All right... the operation's a success!
Well done, everyone!」

rows.speaker: Torres
rows.en: N-no good! Enemy kill count is {tm}! We haven't reached 100!
rows.display_text:
「N-no good! Enemy kill count is {tm}!
We haven't reached 100!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Damn it... the operation's failed! All units, fall back!
rows.display_text:
「Damn it... the operation's failed! All
units, fall back!」

rows.speaker: Torres
rows.en: Enemy reinforcements! Twenty of them!
rows.display_text: 「Enemy reinforcements! Twenty of them!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Our goal is to force the enemy to commit the strength they've been holding back! I expected these reinforcements!
rows.display_text:
「Our goal is to force the enemy to
commit the strength they've been holding
back! I expected these reinforcements!」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: Whittle the enemy down, and reinforcements will come! All units, shoot down as many as you can!
rows.display_text:
「Whittle the enemy down, and
reinforcements will come! All units, shoot
down as many as you can!」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Maelstrom?
rows.display_text: 「Maelstrom?」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: It's the codename for the operation to seize back the Colony Laser that Axis has taken control of.
rows.display_text:
「It's the codename for the operation to
seize back the Colony Laser that Axis has
taken control of.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: Right now, Axis has deployed a Gaza C squadron across the surrounding space to defend it.
rows.display_text:
「Right now, Axis has deployed a Gaza C
squadron across the surrounding space to
defend it.」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: We'll launch a simultaneous attack from all around and seize the Colony Laser at its center.
rows.display_text:
「We'll launch a simultaneous attack from
all around and seize the Colony Laser at
its center.」

rows.speaker: Apolly
rows.en: I see... a spiral encirclement operation, huh.
rows.display_text:
「I see... a spiral encirclement operation,
huh.」

rows.speaker: Roberto
rows.en: So that's why it's called Maelstrom. Pretty clever name.
rows.display_text:
「So that's why it's called Maelstrom.
Pretty clever name.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: But we can expect a tough fight.
rows.display_text: 「But we can expect a tough fight.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: It'll be a joint operation with Captain Henken's group, but as the vanguard, we have to cut down as many of the enemy as we can.
rows.display_text:
「It's a joint op with Capt. Henken's
group, but as vanguard, we must cut down
as many enemies as we can.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: For the operation to succeed, we need to shoot down over 100 enemy units in four minutes.
rows.display_text:
「For the operation to succeed, we need
to shoot down over 100 enemy units in
four minutes.」

rows.speaker: Fa
rows.en: No way...!?
rows.display_text: 「No way...!?」

rows.speaker: Katz
rows.en: A hundred in four minutes...! Our whole force is just the Argama and seven mobile suits!
rows.display_text:
「A hundred in four minutes...! Our whole
force is just the Argama and seven mobile
suits!」

rows.speaker: Emma
rows.en: Lt. Quattro and Kamille, Lt. Apolly and Lt. Roberto, and then me, Katz, and Fa...
rows.display_text:
「Lt. Quattro and Kamille, Lt. Apolly and
Lt. Roberto, and then me, Katz, and Fa...」

rows.speaker: Quattro
rows.en: I'm well aware of how unfavorable this is. But unless we take the Colony Laser back from Haman, this fight won't end.
rows.display_text:
「I'm well aware of how unfavorable this
is. But unless we take the Colony Laser
back from Haman, this fight won't end.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: ...There's nothing to do but go through with it.
rows.display_text:
「...There's nothing to do but go through
with it.」

rows.speaker: Emma
rows.en: Kamille...
rows.display_text: 「Kamille...」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Since there's no other effective option, Operation Maelstrom... we have no choice but to carry it out.
rows.display_text:
「Since there's no other effective option,
Operation Maelstrom... we have no choice
but to carry it out.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: That's right. ...We launch the operation in three hours. Everyone, prepare yourselves.
rows.display_text:
「That's right. ...We launch the operation
in three hours. Everyone, prepare
yourselves.」

rows.speaker: Bright
rows.en: This will be a war of numbers. Set up each unit before launch to maximize its combat endurance.
rows.display_text:
「This will be a war of numbers. Set up
each unit before launch to maximize its
combat endurance.」

rows.speaker: Kamille
rows.en: Understood.
rows.display_text: 「Understood.」
